subject: general
question: ‘Magh Mela 2026’ is celebrated annually in Prayagraj during which period?

options.text: From Chhath Puja to Magh Purnima

solution:
The correct answer is __**From Paush Purnima to Mahashivratri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **‘Magh Mela 2026’ began in Prayagraj, held annually on the banks of the Sangam from Paush Purnima to Mahashivratri, attracting devotees for ritual bathing and charity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Magh Mela is celebrated on the banks of the confluence (Sangam) of Ganges, Yamuna, and Saraswati in Prayagraj.**
 
• Devotees undertake Kalpavas, living simply on the riverbanks, meditating, bathing at Brahma Muhurat, chanting, and performing charity.
 
• The festival enhances spiritual practices due to the sacredness of the three-river confluence.
 
• Held annually during the month of Magh, it is one of the largest religious gatherings in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Prayagraj Significance__

 __
 
• Formerly known as Allahabad, located in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Home to Triveni Sangam, the confluence of Ganga, Yamuna, and mythical Saraswati.
 
 
 
• Kalpavas Practices__
 __
 
• Devotees take a vow to live austerely along the riverbanks for a month.
 
• Includes early morning bathing, meditation, chanting, and performing charity.
 
 
 
• Timing__
 __
 
• Occurs in the Hindu month of Magh (January–February).
 
• Begins from Paush Purnima and continues until Mahashivratri.
 
 
 
• Religious Importance__
 
 
• Bathing at the Sangam is believed to cleanse sins and enhance spiritual merit.
 
• Donation and charity during the Mela are considered highly meritorious.
